headline: Univastu wins Rs 24.36 lakh order from L&T for MMRDA Line 4
summary: Univastu secured a confirmed work order worth Rs 24.36 lakh from Larsen & Toubro for E&M works at Gaimukh Inspection Pit. The firm maintains a robust order book of Rs 601.46 crore, representing 7.53 quarters of average revenue.

headline: Apsis Aerocom wins Rs 4.30 crore order from Healthcare client
summary: Company secures confirmed work order worth Rs 4.296867 crore from a local Healthcare customer. Execution within 7 months. TTM revenue is zero, making book-to-bill metrics unavailable.

headline: Mason Infratech secures Rs 12.9 crore order from Cowtown Infotech
summary: Mason Infratech wins a significant Rs 12.9 crore order for core and shell civil work at Palava Waterfront T2. The 18-month contract adds to its Q2FY27 inflow, bringing total disclosed orders to Rs 23.51 crore.

headline: Bikewo Green Tech wins Rs 66.46 crore order from Reliance
summary: Company secures confirmed work order for EV tractor hiring and operation services. Contract runs till July 2033 with pro-rata payments. Filing notes values are indicative estimates.
